mentions.name: Center Court
mentions.description: This site provides fast live NBA boxscores and statistics, bridging slow mainstream sports sites and advanced stat-focused sites that lack a good live experience. It stores raw play-by-play payloads immutably and derives every statistic as a pure fold over the event log at request time, enabling full re-derivation of a game's state at any point or time range. Pages are server-side rendered with progressive JS enhancements, and URLs are immutable and cached behind a CDN.
mentions.problem: Major sports sites like ESPN.com have terrible UI/UX and slow live boxscores, while advanced stat-focused sites don't offer a good live experience.
mentions.audience: NBA fans looking for a fast, live boxscore experience
mentions.source_excerpt:
After a few false starts over the years, I have a new concept called Center Court that I'm so excited about.

It's primary purpose is for live boxscores because all of the major sports sites have terrible UI/UX experiences.
